topic: A pre-Soulmate Month challenge: enter the most love-charged stretch of the Fire Horse year with intention. One relationship to deepen, one fight to refuse. The month provides the passion; you provide the self-control.
phrases: The month brings the passion. You bring the self-control.
One to deepen. One to skip.
Decide before the heat decides for you.
The best months belong to the ones who showed up knowing what they wanted.
Self-control is what makes passion sustainable.

images.concept: A woman at the threshold of intention. Writing in a journal by morning light, the deliberate act of deciding before the month begins.
images.prompt: A cinematic 16:9 photograph. A woman sits at a wooden desk by a large open window. Morning light pours in from the left. She is writing in a journal, pen in hand, her face turned away from camera in soft profile. On the desk: a ceramic cup of tea, a single stem of white jasmine in a small vase. The mood is deliberate preparation. Not anxious, not hurried. The image of someone deciding, before a month begins, what kind of month she wants to have. Palette: warm ivory light, soft sage in the jasmine stem, antique gold in the tea cup and morning light, midnight jade shadows in the room. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: The two-item list held in open hands. A visual of intentional readiness before a love-charged month.
images.prompt: A cinematic 16:9 overhead shot. A woman's hands rest open in her lap, palms up, holding a small folded piece of paper with two handwritten lines. The words are illegible but clearly a short intentional list. Below her hands, a summer garden is visible in soft focus: grass, a few flowers, warm afternoon light. The mood is readiness and calm before something significant. Natural daylight from directly above. Palette: warm ivory paper, soft sage garden background, antique gold afternoon light, midnight jade shadow at the edges. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Open hands holding a handwritten intention. Simplicity, readiness, and the power of a written decision.
images.prompt: A square close-up photograph. A woman's hands rest open, palms up, holding a small piece of paper with two handwritten lines on it. The lines are illegible but clearly a deliberate short list. Her hands are the subject. Background: a summer garden in soft focus. Shot from slightly above. Natural daylight, soft. The mood is intentional readiness. A decision made and written down before the moment arrives. Palette: warm ivory paper, soft sage garden behind, antique gold light. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: English affirmation card: the one-sentence distillation of the Feel Good Friday challenge. The month brings passion, you bring the self-control.
images.text: The month brings the passion. You bring the self-control.
images.prompt: A square affirmation card, 1080x1080. Warm cream paper background with a soft aged texture. Subtle deckle edges on the top and right, a single faint tea-stain ring in the lower right corner, one folded corner top-left catching gentle shadow. The paper fills the frame edge-to-edge. Overhead natural morning light from the upper left. Rendered in the exact center of the paper, in hand-inked brush lettering, deep walnut ink, the phrase: "The month brings the passion. You bring the self-control." Two lines, centered, the first line slightly larger than the second. The lettering is confident and elegant. Modern calligraphy, not cursive. Spell every word perfectly and space the letters clearly. One tiny hand-drawn ink flourish beneath the second line. Palette: warm cream, walnut brown ink, a single faint blush tea-stain. The overall feeling is intimate, like a page torn from a woman's journal. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
